context: Evaluates correct handling of all four warp phase states (idle, accelerating, cruising, decelerating) using warpPhase and warpIntensity from useWormholeState. Tests that visual effects correctly map to phase transitions and that WARP_CONFIG constants (FOV_NORMAL, FOV_WARP_MAX) are used for effect boundaries.

checklist.name: warpPhase Reading
checklist.description: useWormholeState() is used to read warpPhase and correctly handles all four string values: 'idle', 'accelerating', 'cruising', 'decelerating'

checklist.name: warpIntensity Usage
checklist.description: warpIntensity (0-1 float from useWormholeState) is used to drive continuous effect strength, not just binary on/off switching

checklist.name: WARP_CONFIG Constants
checklist.description: WARP_CONFIG.FOV_NORMAL (75) and WARP_CONFIG.FOV_WARP_MAX (120) are used as bounds for FOV or equivalent effect scaling

checklist.name: Phase Transition Smoothness
checklist.description: Effects interpolate smoothly between phases using warpIntensity rather than snapping, reflecting the easeInQuad/easeOutQuad curves

checklist.name: Idle Baseline
checklist.description: When warpPhase is 'idle' and warpIntensity is 0, all visual effects return to their baseline (no warp distortion)
